summary: Riverside County lookout built by the California Department of Forestry; a lookout station was on the mountain in 1951. No build date found, and no source describes the site today.

facts.agency: Built by the California Department of Forestry; the register names the Riverside County Administration Center as administrator
facts.status_note: No source we read describes what, if anything, remains of the lookout on the mountain.

visit.trail_note: UC Riverside describes Box Springs Mountain Park as 3,400 acres with miles of trails and trailheads near the campus; no source describes access to the former lookout site itself.

notes_for_editor: No build date in any source read; the record has none either. The record's kind 'ground' is not supported by the sources read: the register calls it a Tower Site and the 1951 item says lookout station atop the mountain. The 1951 station is assumed to be this lookout, since the Forest Lookouts page for Box Springs is the only source placing a station there. The register's 'Riverside County Administration Center' is the administrator; the built-by credit is CDF. No source describes access to the lookout site itself or what remains there. rivcoparks.org returned HTTP 403 to fetch_text, so the reserve's own page is unread. The mountain's 3,400-acre figure comes from UC Riverside, not the county. The story gives the register's Moreno Valley location, cites UC Riverside for the 1975 county dedication, and says the 1951 station is not confirmed as this lookout.
